thesis: The page is a Santa Cruz day told in weather: it starts in morning fog and clears to afternoon gold, and every section lives at its hour so a first-timer knows when the counter is quiet and a regular knows when to pre-order before the rush.

signature.name: fog-dial
signature.summary: A round disc (same shape as hero mask) at section edge rotates gradient from fog teal to poppy orange via --sw-p; maps shop hours to time-of-day bands. Reused in hero mask, our-day story, service mini-dials, area map sync, and footer reset. Hook: data-sw-signature='fog-dial'.

motion.intro: Fog gradient drifts off hero disc center-outward in under 1.2 s; h1 line-mask reveals simultaneously. Static disc with reduced motion.
stories: Our-day dial rotation pinned on desktop with hour-band tint shift
Area map town pins light coast-to-mountain in sync with dial via IntersectionObserver stagger
motion.hover: Hairline underline grows scaleX(0→1) from left 200ms; cards lift 2px with shadow. All inside @media (hover:hover).
